title: Wildfire smoke
summary: Smoke can be harmful even far from a fire; local air quality and orders matter.
steps: Check current local air quality and emergency orders when service is available. Leave immediately if officials order evacuation.
If staying home is safe, reduce smoke entering rooms and use a cleaner-air room or appropriate air cleaner if available.
If the home becomes too hot or smoky, seek a safer indoor location. Check on children and people with heart or lung conditions.
Do not rely on a cloth mask to filter wildfire smoke.
